translation.english_text: (Kumudha and Pandiyan are there when Gundumani enters.)
Yes. I've brought three copies here. (hands them over)
If Paranthaman sees this book, he'll become furious.

I did not write it to make him angry. I wrote it so that false leaders like Paranthaman may gain sense, and so that they stop deceiving innocent people. Kumudha! From now on, there must be neither dupes nor gullible fools on this earth!
By 'gullible fools,' do you mean those people who are always grinning whenever you see them? (Kumudha laughs.)

That isn't who I mean. I mean those who surrender their reason to the smiles of frauds, who remain unconcerned no matter what humiliation comes upon them, who lack the courage to ask 'why?' and 'how?' and lie there with their mouths tightly shut—they are the gullible fools.
